summary.text: Lincoln Restler represents the 33rd District on the New York City Council, which includes Greenpoint, Williamsburg, Brooklyn Heights, Downtown Brooklyn, DUMBO and Boerum Hill.
His Council biography says he was previously Deputy Chief of Staff to Mayor Bill de Blasio and chaired the Committee on Governmental Operations.

paragraphs.text: Restler was born and raised in Brooklyn Heights, lived in Greenpoint for over a decade, and now lives in Boerum Hill with his wife and son, according to his Council biography.
He worked in New York City government in the Bloomberg and de Blasio administrations, where the biography says he designed and implemented programs such as IDNYC.
He was Executive Director of the New York City Employment and Training Coalition and helped form the New Kings Democrats, a group focused on transparency and accountability in Brooklyn politics.
